tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Read one incoming invoice. Pass the API key, a publicly reachable file URL and the country code (de, fr, it, pl, ru, kz, by, us, ae, sa, ua, ge). Returns a job id and status. Electronic invoices (XML, QR) are free; scans cost 0.07 EUR per page.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a parse job: structured fields plus export links for accounting.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: How many scanned pages are left on this API key before the next top-up.

tools.name: topup_link
tools.description: Where to top up the API balance. Lava is the seller; the minimum top-up is 8 EUR.
